A.name: Ground truth provenance
details: Identity, camera and scene originate in installed RGBNT100 filename parsing, not teacher predictions. Independently re-parsed every archived train/query/gallery filename: 8675/1715/8575 unique records per split; 50 train identities disjoint from the 50 query/gallery identities. Both manifests are byte-identical and every NPZ identity/camera/scene/name vector matches its manifest.

Evaluation stably sorts distances, removes same-identity AND same-camera gallery items, treats remaining matching IDs as positives, retains different-ID negatives even from the same camera, and uses all 1715 valid queries. No invalid query or subselected gallery was hidden.

The train-only neighbor bank contains exactly the manifest's training labels and records; the bank hash equals the hash bound by the AS run. Teacher-derived neighbor ordering changes sampling, not identity GT. The teacher and the target epoch weights are benchmark-selected, as qualified in E.

Installed split coverage is supported by the archived installed-filename audits, full manifests and 100% cumulative training visitation. The reviewer did not re-enumerate the remote dataset or authenticate the upstream dataset release, because SSH and new execution are excluded.

B.name: Score normalization
details: AS normalizes projected attention Q per head to L2 norm sqrt(8), in FP32 before existing attention. This is a model intervention, not an AP/CMC denominator or a rescaling of reported performance.

The descriptor is unit normalized; squared Euclidean distances are ranked with the shared legal-gallery rule. AP is mean relevant-item precision, INP is positive count divided by last positive rank, and CMC is an indicator averaged across valid queries. Multiplication by 100 is percentage conversion. No mAP/Rank-1 normalization by the model's own max/min/mean was found.

Independent standard-library ranking of every element of eight 1715x8575 distance matrices reproduces all six metrics, CMC1-50, per-query values and identity/camera/scene groups. All saved 5120D feature rows are finite and unit length within 1.2e-7.

Descriptor-to-distance sampling covers all1715 query descriptors against four deterministic gallery indices for each available00/11 feature set (27440 pairs total). Maximum squared-distance error1.009733e-6 is below1e-5 float32-arithmetic tolerance; this is not a full feature-matrix recomputation.

E.name: Scope, budgets, selection and resource claims
details: The new scientific scope is RGBNT100 only, two matched controls, one seed42 each, normal RNT inputs, complete official 8675 train /1715 query /8575 gallery. Four states per selected control are repeated views of the same experiment and queries, not eight independent trainings or eight missing conditions.

Each AS control uses the same original DeMo teacher trained50 (6357 baseline updates), then a fresh Adam/scheduler for additional50 (6563 updates), plus a separate native3 qualification. Lineage is 100 epochs and 12920 formal optimizer updates per arm including the shared teacher, not a fresh50 from public CLIP. The newly launched campaign is 100 added epochs and 13126 formal updates, plus native6. The shared teacher's cost must not be counted twice as newly executed AS compute.

Ordinary and axis AS controls have equal parameter counts 99585158, trainable counts1887366 and descriptor dimension5120; complete record/partial-set order hashes are identical. AS versus AQ also matches additional budget and record order. Original50 has different trainable capacity and PK sampling (K16 versus AS K8), so AS-original is not an equal-budget single-factor architecture comparison.

B64, P8K8, train-only deterministic hard-neighbor scheduling, input128x256, seed42, LR nominal3.5e-4 with bias factor2 and the existing cosine/warmup/noise schedule, Adam, AMP512, main CE.25 + unit5120 hinge.6, M/F auxiliary.001, contribution.05, packed attention QKV decay0, routerT2 and descriptor cap.10 are bound by source plus recorded configs/logs. This intervention is query-only normalization, not full QK normalization or a new learned temperature.

Benchmark mAP is used across50 epochs with earliest ties and the research direction was motivated by earlier benchmark-selected trials. This is not untouched final-test evidence, and it does not quantify training-seed variance or establish broad robustness/causality.

Selected full-QG extraction is 90.2704887390s ordinary /92.4739649296s axis over10290 records including decode and first batch. Whole-process torch allocated peaks are1665325568/1437281792 bytes, not isolated inference peaks or complete process/device memory. Formal wall time9371.0133/9136.6137s includes training, per-epoch evaluations and final extraction and excludes teacher cost. These values do not establish controlled inference speedup or latency efficiency.

AS performed no new missing-modality or49 evaluation and supplies no multi-seed, multi-dataset, foreground, calibrated-contribution or guaranteed-gain claim. Preserve both improvements and regressions; the axis fails the requested mAP-and-Rank1 +1 target.

Archived launches/exits and the controller identify physicalGPU2 ordinary and physicalGPU3 axis, max2 concurrent, one neural job per card. The execution helper queries index/memory only, not temperature/power. No new hardware observation was made in this review.
